go_no_go: CONDITIONAL GO for self-hosted production; CONDITIONAL GO for managed service with caveats

executive_summary.go_no_go: Conditional: proceed with self-hosted deployment after audit remediations; managed service requires P0/P1 remediations before GA
top_5_blockers: 3. No SBOM / dependency vulnerability gate in CI
4. Subnet Stress Pin test flakiness on CI runners
5. Missing WAL fsync boundary / corruption recovery tests

security_fail_closed.summary: Most public binds fail-closed; IPC auth + dashboard TLS enforced. XDP map failure defaults to open — P0 remediate.

concurrency_state.summary: ArcSwap + DashMap + mpsc usage correct; mutex only in boot/IPC; single-writer invariant maintained; poison recovery tested.

resource_performance.summary: Bounded collections enforced; watermark dynamic from Engine capacity; bottleneck catalogue identified; chaos experiments not yet implemented.

config_operability.summary: Hot-reload fields documented; immutable fields enforced at boot; env override test passes; api_set_config immutability check needed.

testing_quality.summary: Integration test coverage good for core paths; unit test gaps in fuzz/property; flaky CI test; mutation testing absent; coverage estimated ~65% → target 80%+

cross_cutting_findings.title: XDP map update failure → FAIL-OPEN
cross_cutting_findings.mechanism: XDP map update failure in handlers.rs returns continue-without-blocking; operators believe they are protected.
cross_cutting_findings.remediation: Add runtime metrics for map failure; document fail-open design; add health check to detect degradation

cross_cutting_findings.title: setcap not enforced on build
cross_cutting_findings.mechanism: setcap command is manual step after cargo build; file capabilities dropped on binary rebuild.
cross_cutting_findings.risk: XDP silently degraded; operator thinks kernel protection active.
cross_cutting_findings.remediation: Add setcap to CI pipeline + postinstall script; verify capability at startup

cross_cutting_findings.title: No SBOM / dep vulnerability gate
cross_cutting_findings.mechanism: cargo-deny not in CI; no SBOM generation; advisories not blocked.
cross_cutting_findings.remediation: Add cargo-deny check to CI gate; generate SBOM; fail build on high/critical advisories

junctions_that_can_spike.current_mitigation: DashMap merge lock; contention > 64 workers → re-shard
junctions_that_can_spike.recommended: Per-worker shard count; eventual consistency on merge results

junctions_that_can_spike.current_mitigation: Kernel BPF map; rate-limited under flood
junctions_that_can_spike.recommended: Batch writes where possible; monitor dropped_events metric

junctions_that_can_spike.current_mitigation: fsync per 67MB segment; latency spike on rotation
junctions_that_can_spike.recommended: background fsync; segment pre-advisory; accept slightly stale durability
background thread; reduce pause via larger word size

junctions_that_can_spike.current_mitigation: O(n) over unique IPs per window; n >= 64 thresholds

hot_path_bottleneck_analysis.recommended_go_arounds: Configure pre_aggs_max_size warning alerts; setcap in CI; add metrics for map failures; add chaos experiments iteratively.

ipc_dashboard.ipc_auth: false (loopback-only, no auth in self-hosted); true for multi-tenant
ipc_dashboard.dashboard_tls: false (terminated externally); true recommended for production

optional_features.mesh: off by default for enterprise; on for multi-node fleets
optional_features.relative_detector: off by default; opt-in after qualification

verification_plan.test_matrix: cargo test -p ramshield-config -p ramshield-detection --locked; cargo test --test queue_under_attack --features full --locked; cargo test --test ipc_wiring --features full --locked
verification_plan.restart_drill:
./target/release/ramshield --config config.stress.toml --no-xdp &
  python3 scripts/subnet_stress.py
  kill $!  # simulate crash
  ./target/release/ramshield --config config.stress.toml --no-xdp &
  python3 scripts/subnet_stress.py
verification_plan.post_restart_checks: verify WAL replay; verify ips_tracked >= 800; verify no duplicate blocks
